advice.headline: Stay the course

moves.text: Pick up Elijah Higgins off waivers (+1.1 points a week) and drop Josh Cameron.

reasons: You're 11-5 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 22%.
A top-2 seed matters: you win the title 31% of the time with the first-round bye and 16% without it. You get the bye in 35% of seasons right now.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 3rd of 8 contenders (180.6 points a week).
Your weakest position is WR (10th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 1st in 2026, 3rd in 2027 and 3rd in 2028 (title chances about 22%, 18%, 18%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.
We tested the best fair trade with 6 teams and none clearly raises your title chance beyond the simulation's margin (about 2 points).
Re-check before the deadline (5 weeks left): injuries change this quickly.
